headline: Timothy Leary broke out of prison and fled to Algeria.
slides: Leary was serving 10 years for two joints' worth of marijuana.
The Brotherhood of Eternal Love, an LSD-distributing group, reportedly paid the Weather Underground to break him out.
He climbed a telephone wire over the fence of a minimum-security prison in San Luis Obispo.
Weather Underground members drove him off and smuggled him out of the country.
He landed with the Black Panthers' exile wing, then fled them too, to Switzerland.
He was caught in Afghanistan and sent back to a California prison.
